items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: I worked there with Michael Moore on bass, or George Mraz or Red Mitchell.

ctx.x: Was there a club called Bradley’s recently that just shut down?

Yeah. It shut down unfortunately. I used to play there — when we moved out of the city a little over twenty years ago, and I lived about three blocks from Bradley’s. I worked there many times. It was a wonderful place to play. And the last time I worked there was when I first moved out of the city. But that was ridiculous. I’d finish at two or three in the morning and drive to my house. I’d get home at like five in the morning and I said oh God. But that was a great room to play. A great room. I worked there with…
That’s what — I think it was Ray Drummond was telling me that.
